instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: Maria is at the Stage 3 follow-up visit after fear, cost, scheduling, and caregiver barriers have been addressed. Influenza vaccine and the first recombinant zoster vaccine dose have been given. Colonoscopy is scheduled with plan-specific coverage reviewed by the financial counselor, Pap/HPV co-testing is scheduled with the colonoscopy-prep teaching visit, and teach-back has revealed that Maria would wait to report new symptoms before the colonoscopy. Complete the bow-tie diagram.
